title: Baked oats with grapes and apple

grandparents_cupboard.reason: Oats, eggs, milk, butter, honey, fruit, almonds and yoghurt are all plain home staples.

supermarket.reason: Every item, including red grapes and flaked almonds, is an everyday Tesco purchase.

basic_kitchen.reason: It needs only a baking dish, bowl, whisk, grater and oven, with simple mixing and baking.

works.reason: The ratio of 200g oats to 500ml milk and 2 eggs, baked 30 to 35 minutes at 190°C (170°C fan), gives a properly set dish for four.

honest_times.reason: Ten minutes covers grating one apple, halving the grapes and whisking, and the 35 minutes cooking matches the bake.

honest_ingredients.reason: Every listed ingredient and seasoning is used, flaked almonds and red grapes match their ids, and nothing unlisted appears.

seasonal_feel.reason: A warm fruit bake suits late September, and 300g of grapes scattered across the top makes them the point of the dish.

plain_voice.reason: The steps are clear, plain British English a beginner can follow.

hearty_healthy.reason: Oats, eggs, milk, fruit and yoghurt make a filling breakfast with only modest added honey.
